page_title: PAL 2-2 BET | Las Palmas v Betis 16/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's all for today as the game is over.

90+7' What a big chance! Pejino (Las Palmas) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball a whisker wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Betis.
90+6' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) commits a foul and Javier Iglesias Villanueva immediately signals a free kick. It's a free kick to Las Palmas, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
90+3' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Betis was in an offside position.
90+3' Nabil Fekir (Betis) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
90+2' Rodri (Betis) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety. Corner kick. Betis will have an opportunity.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
90' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta prepares a substitution. Alex Suarez is replaced by Jose Campana (Las Palmas).
89' Rodri (Betis) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
88' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Pejino (Las Palmas) comes onto the pitch so that Sandro Ramirez can be given a rest.
88' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Nabil Fekir (Betis) heads on.
86' The attendance for today's match is 22606.
85' The linesman raises his flag. Alex Suarez (Las Palmas) is adjudged offside.
85' The referee awards a corner and Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) goes over to take it.

84' Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it. The ball goes out for a corner. Las Palmas can continue in their attacking effort.
83' Dangerous play by Nabil Fekir (Betis). Javier Iglesias Villanueva blows his whistle for a foul. Las Palmas have a free kick.
82' Betis work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
81' Nabil Fekir (Betis) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick, but his poor effort goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Las Palmas.
81' Javier Iglesias Villanueva interrupts the game. One of the players from Las Palmas won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. That's a free kick to Betis.
79' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) latches onto a cross but somehow sends his close-range header high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Betis will have a goal kick.
75' Manuel Pellegrini has decided to make a change. William Carvalho (Betis) replaces Marc Roca.
75' Substitution. Rodri (Betis) on for Pablo Fornals.
75' Here comes the ref’s decision after the VAR review. It’s not penalty to Betis as the referee indicates there was no infringement!
74' Referee Javier Iglesias Villanueva makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Betis. Let’s see what happens!
74' Surely that's handball by one of the Las Palmas players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
72' Nabil Fekir (Betis) releases a promising shot from the free kick on the edge of the box. His effort towards the right post is comfortably saved by Alvaro Valles.
71' Saul Coco (Las Palmas) sees a yellow card from Javier Iglesias Villanueva after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
70' Nabil Fekir (Betis) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
68' Javier Munoz (Las Palmas) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Betis.
68' Nabil Fekir (Betis) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
66' Here is a change. Enzo Loiodice is going off and Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta gives the last tactical orders to Javier Munoz (Las Palmas).
66' The referee signals a substitution. Marc Cardona (Las Palmas) is brought on as a substitute for Munir El Haddadi.
64' 2 - 2 Goal! Enzo Loiodice tees up Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) inside the box, and he keeps his cool to find the bottom right corner. 2:2.
63' Hector Bellerin (Betis) makes a strong challenge and Javier Iglesias Villanueva blows for a foul. Las Palmas have been awarded a free kick.
63' Flag up against Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
61' Betis can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
60' The resulting set piece from Betis is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
58' Las Palmas are ruled offside.
58' Munir El Haddadi (Las Palmas) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
58' Las Palmas quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

58' Marvin (Las Palmas) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. The ball is out of play. Las Palmas will have a chance to score from a corner.
53' Marvin (Las Palmas) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the top of net only for Rui Silva to dive and make a save.
53' A player from Betis commits a rough challenge. Javier Iglesias Villanueva blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. Las Palmas have a free kick.
51' Nabil Fekir (Betis) touches the ball with his hand. Free kick. Las Palmas will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
49' 1 - 2 It's a goal! Ayoze Perez (Betis) scores with a brilliant shot into the top right corner after being released inside the box by a superb lofted pass from Abner. The score is now 1:2.
47' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Munir El Haddadi (Las Palmas) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
46' Manuel Pellegrini has made a change at the break. Hector Bellerin (Betis) has come on in place of Aitor Ruibal.
46' The whistle blows and Javier Iglesias Villanueva starts the second half.
45+8' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+7' Marvin (Las Palmas) picks up the rebound just outside the box and releases a weak low shot that heads towards the right post, but it fails to give the goalkeeper anything to worry about.
45+7' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
45+4' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.

45+3' A player from Betis commits a rough challenge. Javier Iglesias Villanueva blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. Las Palmas win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
45+3' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Las Palmas for a penalty. Play continues.
45' We will have 7 min. of added time.
45' The linesman signals that Munir El Haddadi (Las Palmas) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
45' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Alex Suarez (Las Palmas).

43' Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) receives a low pass just outside the box and drills a fine strike towards the middle of the goal. Rui Silva pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
42' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
39' Isco (Betis) is being substituted because of an injury. Manuel Pellegrini sends Nabil Fekir on the pitch.
37' Isco (Betis) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
34' Isco (Betis) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
33' Poor challenge! Isco (Betis) is penalised for tripping and Javier Iglesias Villanueva blows his whistle. There is a free kick near the sideline to Las Palmas.
33' A corner kick by Betis is thwarted by the well prepared Alvaro Valles (Las Palmas).
31' Chadi Riad (Betis) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle. Las Palmas will take a free kick.
31' Abner (Betis) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
30' Javier Iglesias Villanueva interrupts the game. One of the players from Las Palmas won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. A free kick has been awarded to Betis.
29' The game is interrupted as Ayoze Perez (Betis) is flagged offside.
28' 1 - 1 Goal! Alex Suarez (Las Palmas) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the right side of the goal. It's 1:1.
27' Javier Iglesias Villanueva shows a yellow card to Aitor Ruibal (Betis), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
25' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) fails to deliver a decent cross from the corner and the ball goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Betis will have a goal kick.
24' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. Las Palmas have been awarded a corner kick.
22' 0 - 1 It's an own goal! Mika Marmol (Las Palmas) beats his own goalkeeper.
20' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Betis.
20' Guido Rodriguez has picked up an injury and is replaced by Johnny Cardoso (Betis).
19' Ayoze Perez (Betis) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. Now Betis have a corner.
19' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Enzo Loiodice (Las Palmas). Betis will take a free kick near the side line.
17' Javier Iglesias Villanueva couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Chadi Riad (Betis) and blew his whistle. It's a free kick to Las Palmas in a dangerous position.
16' Flag goes up against Ayoze Perez (Betis) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
13' Javier Iglesias Villanueva blows his whistle after Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. Betis are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
12' Munir El Haddadi (Las Palmas) is adjudged offside.
12' Munir El Haddadi (Las Palmas) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots low to the middle of the goal, but Rui Silva pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.

9' Kirian Rodriguez (Las Palmas) has a chance after receiving a pass. He measures his shot from the edge of the box but it sails just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Betis.
9' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
8' One of the players from Betis times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
6' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Betis, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
5' Javier Iglesias Villanueva rightly pulls out a yellow card and shows it to Alex Suarez (Las Palmas).
4' Isco (Betis) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.

3' It looks like Sokratis Papastathopoulos (Betis) saw red with that tackle. Javier Iglesias Villanueva won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Las Palmas.
1' The first half has started.
Las Palmas will kick the game off.
Javier Iglesias Villanueva will supervise the game today.
